description_zh: 调用ModifyUserPasswords修改一个或多个用户的密码
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc modify-user-passwords --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --user Password=1@a0000 Name=user1 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyUserPasswords

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

fields.help_en:
The username of the user whose password you want to change.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html operation to query the usernames in the cluster
fields.help_zh:
要修改密码的用户的用户名。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html获取该集群中的用户名
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The new password for the user. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length and contain at least three of the following character types:

Uppercase letter
Lowercase letter
Digit
Special character: `()~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'/<>,.?/`

We recommend that you use HTTPS to call this operation to avoid password leaks
fields.help_zh:
用户的新密码。长度为8~30个字符，必须同时包含一下四项中的三项：

大写英文字母
小写英文字母
数字
特殊字符：`()~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'/<>,.?/`

建议使用HTTPS协议调用API以避免可能发生的密码泄露
fields.name: password

parameters.help_en: The users. You can specify 1 to 100 users
parameters.help_zh: 用户信息。可以传入1~100个用户信息
parameters.name: user

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the asynchronous mode for this request.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
采用异步消息链路修改用户密码。

默认值：false
parameters.name: async
